    """Improved Best Fit / Almost Worst Fit adaptive priority function.
    
    Prefers tight fits (Best Fit) especially when the remaining gap is very small
    or zero. However, when placing into a bin leaves an awkward tiny leftover space
    that cannot easily fit future items, it penalizes such placements in favor of

    if rem.size == 0:

    scores -= 0.5 * awkward_penalty

    # except when an item is very large and fits poorly into remaining spaces
    new_bin_score = -0.5
    
    return np.append(scores, new_bin_score)
